title: The blade's teeth
logline: The head saw's band, close, stopped: the teeth in a row across the whole page, each one drawn, oil on the steel, sawdust in the gullets. The Era I spotting is the teeth. The mill has five months.

panels.composition: Extreme close-up of a bandsaw blade's teeth running across the whole page, each tooth drawn, oil sheen on the steel, sawdust packed in the gullets, nothing else.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, in the Era I manner, heavy black spotting brought back on purpose, an extreme close-up of a bandsaw blade's teeth running across the whole page with each tooth drawn, oil sheen on the steel and sawdust packed in the gullets, nothing else, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: Each tooth. The spotting is the teeth.
